open_points.subject: MCP/internal error contract
open_points.text: `internal_error` | `nothing was changed; no detail (A16 rule 7)` ... and later: `When a request makes several store changes, those made before the failed one stay` ... and `stop_required` ... `that record was written`.
open_points.question: When the MCP surface returns `internal_error`, must callers assume the whole request had no state effects, or may earlier store changes in that same request already be committed?
options: `internal_error` guarantees zero state change for the whole request
`internal_error` means only the failing store call changed nothing; earlier successful store calls may remain committed
`internal_error` has two classes (no-change vs partial-change) and the response must distinguish them
open_points.default_guess: `internal_error` can be returned after partial progress; only the failed store call is guaranteed to have changed nothing.

open_points.subject: store.read_records relation: trial executions over corpus digest
open_points.text: `trial executions of an implementation over a corpus digest` -> `the latest TrialExecution M07 per case of that corpus`
open_points.question: If one or more corpus cases have no TrialExecution for that implementation+corpus digest, what must this relation return?
options: Refuse the call because the per-case set is incomplete
Return only existing TrialExecution records and omit missing cases
Return one entry per corpus case, including explicit `missing` placeholders
open_points.default_guess: Return only existing TrialExecution records and omit missing cases.

open_points.subject: SpooledFile identity used by read_spooled_file/store.read_value_bytes
open_points.text: `A SpooledFile as read_spooled_file says` and `read_spooled_file names a SpooledFile M22 by its identity — run_id, producer_node_id, map_index, attempt_number, producer_port, list_index`
open_points.question: Is this tuple the canonical identity key for SpooledFile records everywhere, or only a lookup key that may match multiple records unless digest/size/media_type are also part of identity?
options: The tuple is the full unique identity of SpooledFile
The tuple is only a lookup prefix; full identity also includes content facts
SpooledFile should have a separate minted/computed id and this tuple is not identity
open_points.default_guess: Treat the tuple as the full unique identity for SpooledFile records.

open_points.subject: service_invoker.send_prepared_request output for zero-output bindings
open_points.text: `when the response is used, the output values by port, or for a file output its bytes ...` while A09 says `a binding without output ports ignores the body`.
open_points.question: For a successful response on a binding with no output ports, what exact output payload must `send_prepared_request` return to its caller?
open_points.default_guess: Return an explicit empty outputs map/object.
